title: Manyhands JSON v1 remote removal preview
description: The data of a prepare envelope that gives a preview of remote remove: what the removal will do, and the confirmation an execute of the same command, repository and remote presents to do it. A prepare that gives no preview carries no preview data: a rejection, as for the publication remote, and a no-op for a repository that has no such remote.

confirmation_id.description: What an execute presents as its consent. It is accepted by one request.

expires_at.description: When the confirmation stops being accepted by a new request: ten minutes after the preview. A request that has accepted it is honored afterwards.

command.description: The command the confirmation is for, as an envelope names it.

effects.description: What the command will do, in the order it does it.

details.description: The remote that will be removed from the repository's own Git configuration, and what its removal touches.

fetch_location.description: Where the remote fetches from, redacted as the remote list redacts it: not a location to connect to. Null for a remote whose location that list does not give.

push_location.description: Where the remote pushes to, redacted in the same way.

publication_affected.description: Whether the remote is the one the repository publishes to. A preview is given only of a remote that is not, so this is false.

polling_affected.description: Whether the repository's polling state names this remote, and so has nothing to observe once it is removed.
